summary: Revised implementation plan incorporating Age of Empires II: DE Patch 185872, including The Viking Sagas DLC (Danes, Saxons, Varangians), The Last Chieftains DLC (Mapuche, Muisca, Tupi), The Mountain Royals (Armenians, Georgians), Return of Rome (Romans), Dynasties of India, Dawn of the Dukes, and Lords of the West, with all new units and regional additions (Varangian Guard, Mounted Crossbowman, Jomsviking, Hearth Troop, Bolas Rider, Kona, Guecha Warrior, Ibirapema Warrior).
